title: UGC Creator
why_it_fits: Content Specialist match. 3 skills: word, customer support, admin. Likely PH eligibility signal
why_it_might_not: Confirm Philippines eligibility before applying. Salary not disclosed
position_overview: The hard center of this role: turning real Ren tasks (the calls, the cancellations, the 47-minute holds) into content that travels on its own. One post that reads as an ad costs the deadpan permanently, so the register isn't a style choice here. It's the distribution. T-SHAPED, DEEP IN AT LEAST ONE Short-form video. Shooting and cutting phone-native video from real raw material: call recordings, screen captures, field footage. Hooks that earn the first second, payoffs that earn the repost. The deadpan register. Writing and performing flat institutional comedy the situation is deranged, the delivery never is. If you can't do dry, nothing else transfers. Editorial artifacts. Turning call data into things people screenshot and cite: the Cancellation Index, hold-time leaderboards, "dear [institution]" letters. Content that holds up as journalism, not just posts. Organic distribution. Knowing why something traveled and proving it with numbers instead of vibes. No paid amplification, ever. Paid-campaign instincts corrupt the signal and fail the swap test. OUR STACK We shoot phone-first and cut in whatever you're fastest in, off a growing archive of real call recordings and a locked brand system. There is no ad budget and there won't be one. Not knowing our exact tools isn't a dealbreaker; taste and reps are.
